properties.site-address: Council waste depot at the end of Prospect Way
properties.notes: Sites lies within the inner area of a health and safety executive consultation zone, however this restraint is planned to be removed by the promoter as part of the redevelopment of the site. Area benefitting from flood defences. Floodzone 3 on the majority of the site, apart from the southwest corner, which is in floodzone 2. Areas of possible ground contamination from former uses
